title: NEET UG re-test LIVE updates: CCTV, jammers and tight security mark exam day; NTA on alert
description: NEET UG re-exam LIVE updates: Without naming anyone, Dharmendra Pradhan criticised "some so-called responsible people" for their conduct. "They treated children with ulterior motives and ill intentions… if you consider yourself a true citizen of India, please take responsibility," he said.
